<!-- Author: Kunru Song -->

Existing RDA object identifiers are retained for compatibility. Mplus folders,
run-file prefixes, reports, tables and figures use the current analysis numbering.

# Scientific question and model design

This analysis tests whether baseline Trait Peripheral and Trait Core PSMU
factors are associated with latent baseline depression, anxiety, and perceived stress. All five constructs are represented by their raw items rather
than scale totals.

Two models are estimated with local Mplus 8.7 through R `MplusAutomation`:

1. a five-factor measurement model in which all latent factors correlate;
2. a structural model in which latent depression, anxiety, and
   perceived stress are simultaneously regressed on latent Peripheral and Core.

The structural model freely estimates the Peripheral--Core covariance and the
residual covariances among the three endogenous outcome factors. This allows depression, anxiety, and stress to remain associated after accounting for PSMU. With these residual covariances, the two
models are covariance-equivalent parameterizations and should have identical
global fit; the structural model supplies the mutually adjusted regression
paths.

The 42 indicators are treated as ordered categorical with WLSMV and Delta
parameterization, matching the primary baseline CFA estimator. The documented
anxiety shift and perceived-stress reversals are applied only to the generated
S2.4 analysis data; the canonical S2.1 raw-item RDA is not modified.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
locate_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!dir.exists(candidate)) candidate <- dirname(candidate)
  repeat {
    if (all(dir.exists(file.path(candidate, c(
      "Step_1_Descriptive_and_Reliability", "Step_2_Measurement_Models"
    ))))) return(candidate)
    parent <- dirname(candidate)
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) break
    candidate <- parent
  }
  stop("Could not identify the project root from the public Step folders")
}

load_single_object <- function(path, expected_name) {
  environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  loaded <- load(path, envir = environment)
  if (!identical(loaded, expected_name)) {
    stop(
      "Expected ", expected_name, " in ", path,
      "; found: ", paste(loaded, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  environment[[expected_name]]
}

clean_mplus_numeric <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x[abs(x) >= 900] <- NA_real_
  x
}
```

# Load and validate the expanded S2.1 baseline entry

```{r load-and-validate-input}
dat_step2_measurement <- load_single_object(
  measurement_file,
  "dat_step2_measurement"
)

psmu_items <- paste0("V_BSMAS_", 1:18)
depression_items <- paste0("K_CESD_", 1:7)
anxiety_items <- paste0("L_DASS_", 1:7)
stress_items <- paste0("M_PSS_", 1:10)
all_model_items <- c(
  psmu_items,
  depression_items,
  anxiety_items,
  stress_items
)
required_columns <- c("Name_ID", all_model_items)

dat_baseline_raw <- dat_step2_measurement$baseline |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(required_columns)) |>
  as.data.frame()

stopifnot(
  identical(
    names(dat_step2_measurement),
    c("baseline", "ema", "item_map", "audit")
  ),
  nrow(dat_step2_measurement$baseline) == 209L,
  ncol(dat_step2_measurement$baseline) == 43L,
  nrow(dat_step2_measurement$item_map) == 48L,
  identical(names(dat_baseline_raw), required_columns),
  nrow(dat_baseline_raw) == 209L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(dat_baseline_raw$Name_ID) == 209L,
  !anyNA(dat_baseline_raw),
  all(vapply(dat_baseline_raw[psmu_items], function(x) all(x %in% 1:5), logical(1))),
  all(vapply(dat_baseline_raw[depression_items], function(x) all(x %in% 1:4), logical(1))),
  all(vapply(dat_baseline_raw[anxiety_items], function(x) all(x %in% 1:4), logical(1))),
  all(vapply(dat_baseline_raw[stress_items], function(x) all(x %in% 1:5), logical(1)))
)

input_audit <- data.frame(
  participants = nrow(dat_baseline_raw),
  raw_items = length(all_model_items),
  missing_item_cells = sum(is.na(dat_baseline_raw[all_model_items])),
  measurement_rda_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(measurement_file)),
  generated_by = dat_step2_measurement$audit$generated_by,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(input_audit)
```

# Apply the documented analysis-only transformations

```{r transform-and-map-items}
dat_baseline_sem <- dat_baseline_raw
dat_baseline_sem[anxiety_items] <- lapply(
  dat_baseline_sem[anxiety_items],

)
stress_reverse_items <- c("M_PSS_4", "M_PSS_5", "M_PSS_7", "M_PSS_8")
dat_baseline_sem[stress_reverse_items] <- lapply(
  dat_baseline_sem[stress_reverse_items],
  function(x) 6 - x
)

mplus_names <- c(
  paste0("bs", 1:18),
  paste0("d", 1:7),
  paste0("a", 1:7),
  paste0("s", 1:10)
)
constructs <- c(
  rep("Trait PSMU", 18),
  rep("Depression", 7),
  rep("Anxiety", 7),
  rep("Perceived stress", 10)
)

  rep(c("PERIPH", "CORE"), c(6, 12)),
  rep("DEP", 7),
  rep("ANX", 7),
  rep("STR", 10)
)
transformations <- c(
  rep("Raw 1-5", 18),
  rep("Raw 1-4", 7),
  rep("Shifted from 1-4 to 0-3 using x - 1", 7),

variable_map <- data.frame(

stopifnot(

  all(vapply(mplus_data[paste0("bs", 1:18)], function(x) all(x %in% 1:5), logical(1))),

  all(vapply(mplus_data[paste0("a", 1:7)], function(x) all(x %in% 0:3), logical(1))),
  all(vapply(mplus_data[paste0("s", 1:10)], function(x) all(x %in% 1:5), logical(1))),
  length(unique(substr(mplus_names, 1L, 8L))) == 42L
)

transformation_audit <- variable_map |>
```

# Specify the measurement and structural models

```{r model-specifications}
measurement_syntax <- paste(
  "periph BY bs1-bs6;",
  "core BY bs7-bs18;",
  "dep BY d1-d7;",
  "anx BY a1-a7;",
  "str BY s1-s10;",
  "periph WITH core dep anx str;",
  "core WITH dep anx str;",
  "dep WITH anx str;",
  "anx WITH str;",
  sep = "\n"
)

structural_syntax <- paste(
  "periph BY bs1-bs6;",
  "core BY bs7-bs18;",
  "dep BY d1-d7;",
  "anx BY a1-a7;",
  "str BY s1-s10;",
  "dep anx str ON periph core;",
  "periph WITH core;",
  "dep WITH anx str;",
  "anx WITH str;",
  sep = "\n"
)

model_specs <- list(
  Measurement_5Factor = list(
    label = "Five-factor measurement model",
    stem = "s2_4_measurement_5factor",
    model = measurement_syntax,
    structural = FALSE
  ),
  Structural_CorePeripheral = list(
    label = "Core and Peripheral predicting three latent outcomes",
    stem = "s2_4_structural_core_peripheral",
    model = structural_syntax,
    structural = TRUE
  )
)

model_plan <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(model_specs), function(model_id) {
  specification <- model_specs[[model_id]]
  data.frame(
    model_id = model_id,
    model = specification$label,
    estimator = "WLSMV",
    parameterization = "DELTA",
    participants = 209L,
    indicators = 42L,
    latent_factors = 5L,
    structural_paths = ifelse(specification$structural, 6L, 0L),
    outcome_residual_covariances = ifelse(specification$structural, 3L, NA_integer_),
    mplus_input = paste0(specification$stem, ".inp"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

knitr::kable(model_plan)
```

# Generate and run both models in Mplus 8.7

```{r run-mplus-models}
run_sem_model <- function(model_id, specification) {
  data_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".dat"))
  input_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".inp"))
  output_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".out"))

  mplus_object <- MplusAutomation::mplusObject(
    TITLE = paste(
      "! Author: Kunru Song",
      paste0("S2.4 ", specification$label, ";"),
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    VARIABLE = paste0(
      "CATEGORICAL = bs1-bs18 d1-d7 a1-a7 s1-s10;"
    ),
    ANALYSIS = paste(
      "ESTIMATOR = WLSMV;",
      "PARAMETERIZATION = DELTA;",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    MODEL = specification$model,
    OUTPUT = paste(
      "SAMPSTAT;",
      "STANDARDIZED(STDYX);",
      "CINTERVAL;",
      "RESIDUAL;",
      "TECH1;",
      "TECH4;",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    usevariables = mplus_names,
    rdata = mplus_data,
    autov = FALSE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  MplusAutomation::mplusModeler(
    object = mplus_object,
    dataout = data_path,
    modelout = input_path,
    run = 1L,
    check = FALSE,
    varwarnings = TRUE,
    Mplus_command = mplus_command,
    writeData = "always",
    hashfilename = FALSE,
    killOnFail = TRUE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  stopifnot(file.exists(data_path), file.exists(input_path), file.exists(output_path))
  input_lines <- readLines(input_path, warn = FALSE)
  output_lines <- readLines(output_path, warn = FALSE)
  parsed <- MplusAutomation::readModels(output_path, what = "all", quiet = TRUE)

  checks <- list(
    author_present = any(trimws(input_lines) == "! Author: Kunru Song"),
    categorical_declared = any(grepl(
      "CATEGORICAL\\s*=\\s*bs1-bs18 d1-d7 a1-a7 s1-s10;",
      input_lines,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      perl = TRUE
    )),
    wlsmv_declared = any(grepl(
      "ESTIMATOR\\s*=\\s*WLSMV;",
      input_lines,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      perl = TRUE
    )),
    delta_declared = any(grepl(
      "PARAMETERIZATION\\s*=\\s*DELTA;",
      input_lines,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      perl = TRUE
    )),
    no_posthoc_modification = !any(grepl(
      "MODINDICES|MODEL MODIFICATION|WITH bs|WITH d[0-9]|WITH a[0-9]|WITH s[0-9]",
      input_lines,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      perl = TRUE
    )),
    normal_termination = any(grepl(
      "THE MODEL ESTIMATION TERMINATED NORMALLY",
      output_lines,
      fixed = TRUE
    )),
    no_fatal_error = !any(grepl("*** ERROR", output_lines, fixed = TRUE)),
    mplus_version_ok = any(grepl("Mplus VERSION 8.7", output_lines, fixed = TRUE))
  )

  stopifnot(
    all(unlist(checks)),
    is.list(parsed),
    identical(as.character(parsed$summaries$Mplus.version), "8.7"),
    identical(as.character(parsed$summaries$Estimator), "WLSMV"),
    as.integer(parsed$summaries$Observations) == 209L
  )

  list(
    model_id = model_id,
    model_label = specification$label,
    model_syntax = specification$model,
    structural = specification$structural,
    paths = c(data = data_path, input = input_path, output = output_path),
    parsed = parsed,
    output_lines = output_lines,
    checks = checks
  )
}

model_runs <- lapply(names(model_specs), function(model_id) {
  run_sem_model(model_id, model_specs[[model_id]])
})
names(model_runs) <- names(model_specs)
```

# Extract fit, loadings, latent relations, and structural paths

```{r extract-results}
factor_label_map <- c(
  PERIPH = "Trait Peripheral PSMU",
  CORE = "Trait Core PSMU",
  DEP = "Depression",
  ANX = "Anxiety",
  STR = "Perceived stress"
)

extract_fit <- function(run) {
  summary_row <- run$parsed$summaries
  data.frame(
    model_id = run$model_id,
    model = run$model_label,
    mplus_version = as.character(summary_row$Mplus.version),
    estimator = as.character(summary_row$Estimator),
    observations = as.integer(summary_row$Observations),
    free_parameters = as.integer(summary_row$Parameters),
    chi_square = as.numeric(summary_row$ChiSqM_Value),
    df = as.integer(summary_row$ChiSqM_DF),
    p_value = as.numeric(summary_row$ChiSqM_PValue),
    cfi = as.numeric(summary_row$CFI),
    tli = as.numeric(summary_row$TLI),
    rmsea = as.numeric(summary_row$RMSEA_Estimate),
    rmsea_ci_lower = as.numeric(summary_row$RMSEA_90CI_LB),
    rmsea_ci_upper = as.numeric(summary_row$RMSEA_90CI_UB),
    srmr = as.numeric(summary_row$SRMR),
    normal_termination = run$checks$normal_termination,
    warnings_n = length(run$parsed$warnings),
    errors_n = length(run$parsed$errors),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

model_fit <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_fit))

extract_loadings <- function(run) {
  unstandardized <- run$parsed$parameters$unstandardized
  standardized <- run$parsed$parameters$stdyx.standardized
  confidence <- run$parsed$parameters$ci.stdyx.standardized
  r2 <- run$parsed$parameters$r2

  std_rows <- standardized |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("\\.BY$", paramHeader)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      paramHeader,
      mplus_variable = param,
      standardized_loading = clean_mplus_numeric(est),
      standardized_se = clean_mplus_numeric(se),
      standardized_z = clean_mplus_numeric(est_se),
      standardized_p = clean_mplus_numeric(pval)
    )
  unstd_rows <- unstandardized |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("\\.BY$", paramHeader)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      paramHeader,
      mplus_variable = param,
      unstandardized_loading = clean_mplus_numeric(est),
      unstandardized_se = clean_mplus_numeric(se),
      unstandardized_z = clean_mplus_numeric(est_se),
      unstandardized_p = clean_mplus_numeric(pval)
    )
  ci_rows <- confidence |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("\\.BY$", paramHeader)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      paramHeader,
      mplus_variable = param,
      standardized_ci_lower = clean_mplus_numeric(low2.5),
      standardized_ci_upper = clean_mplus_numeric(up2.5)
    )
  r2_rows <- r2 |>
    dplyr::filter(param %in% toupper(mplus_names)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      mplus_variable = param,
      item_r_squared = clean_mplus_numeric(est),
      standardized_residual_variance = clean_mplus_numeric(resid_var)
    )

  std_rows |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      unstd_rows,
      by = c("paramHeader", "mplus_variable")
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      ci_rows,
      by = c("paramHeader", "mplus_variable")
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(r2_rows, by = "mplus_variable") |>
    dplyr::left_join(variable_map, by = "mplus_variable") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model_id = run$model_id,
      model = run$model_label,
      factor = sub("\\.BY$", "", paramHeader),
      factor_label = unname(factor_label_map[factor]),
      loading_estimation = ifelse(
        is.na(unstandardized_se) | unstandardized_se == 0,
        "Marker loading fixed at 1",
        "Freely estimated loading"
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      model_id,
      model,
      factor,
      factor_label,
      item_order,
      project_variable,
      mplus_variable,
      construct,
      transformation,
      loading_estimation,
      unstandardized_loading,
      unstandardized_se,
      unstandardized_z,
      unstandardized_p,
      standardized_loading,
      standardized_se,
      standardized_z,
      standardized_p,
      standardized_ci_lower,
      standardized_ci_upper,
      item_r_squared,
      standardized_residual_variance
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(item_order)
}

loadings <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_loadings))

extract_factor_relations <- function(run) {
  standardized <- run$parsed$parameters$stdyx.standardized
  confidence <- run$parsed$parameters$ci.stdyx.standardized
  relations <- standardized |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("\\.WITH$", paramHeader)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      paramHeader,
      factor_2 = param,
      estimate = clean_mplus_numeric(est),
      se = clean_mplus_numeric(se),
      z = clean_mplus_numeric(est_se),
      p_value = clean_mplus_numeric(pval)
    )
  relation_ci <- confidence |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("\\.WITH$", paramHeader)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      paramHeader,
      factor_2 = param,
      ci_lower = clean_mplus_numeric(low2.5),
      ci_upper = clean_mplus_numeric(up2.5)
    )

  relations |>
    dplyr::left_join(relation_ci, by = c("paramHeader", "factor_2")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model_id = run$model_id,
      model = run$model_label,
      factor_1 = sub("\\.WITH$", "", paramHeader),
      factor_1_label = unname(factor_label_map[factor_1]),
      factor_2_label = unname(factor_label_map[factor_2]),
      relation_type = dplyr::case_when(
        !run$structural ~ "Latent factor correlation",
        factor_1 %in% c("PERIPH", "CORE") &
          factor_2 %in% c("PERIPH", "CORE") ~ "Exogenous factor correlation",
        TRUE ~ "Residual correlation among endogenous outcomes"
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      model_id,
      model,
      relation_type,
      factor_1,
      factor_1_label,
      factor_2,
      factor_2_label,
      estimate,
      se,
      z,
      p_value,
      ci_lower,
      ci_upper
    )
}

factor_relations <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_factor_relations))

    unstandardized_se,

    standardized_estimate,
    standardized_se,
    standardized_z,
    standardized_p,
    standardized_ci_lower,
    standardized_ci_upper,
    outcome_r_squared
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    match(outcome, c("DEP", "ANX", "STR")),
    match(predictor, c("PERIPH", "CORE"))
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(model_fit) == 2L,
  nrow(loadings) == 84L,
  all(table(loadings$model_id) == 42L),
  all(is.finite(loadings$standardized_loading)),
  all(is.finite(loadings$standardized_ci_lower)),
  all(is.finite(loadings$standardized_ci_upper)),
  nrow(factor_relations) == 14L,
  nrow(structural_paths) == 6L,
  identical(unique(structural_paths$outcome), c("DEP", "ANX", "STR")),
  all(sort(unique(structural_paths$predictor)) == c("CORE", "PERIPH")),
  all(is.finite(structural_paths$standardized_estimate)),
  all(is.finite(structural_paths$standardized_ci_lower)),
  all(is.finite(structural_paths$standardized_ci_upper)),
  all(is.finite(structural_paths$outcome_r_squared))
)

fit_equivalence <- data.frame(
```

# Diagnose admissibility and interpretation limits

```{r diagnostics}
extract_diagnostics <- function(run) {
  model_loadings <- loadings[loadings$model_id == run$model_id, , drop = FALSE]
  model_relations <- factor_relations[
    factor_relations$model_id == run$model_id,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  unstandardized <- run$parsed$parameters$unstandardized
  factor_variances <- unstandardized |>
    dplyr::filter(
      paramHeader %in% c("Variances", "Residual.Variances"),
      param %in% names(factor_label_map)
    ) |>
    dplyr::pull(est) |>
    clean_mplus_numeric()

  loading_bounds_ok <- all(
    abs(model_loadings$standardized_loading) <= 1.01,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  item_residuals_nonnegative <- all(
    model_loadings$standardized_residual_variance >= -1e-6,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  factor_variances_positive <- length(factor_variances) >= 2L &&
    all(factor_variances > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  factor_relations_within_bounds <- all(
    abs(model_relations$estimate) < 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  structural_paths_complete <- if (run$structural) {
    nrow(structural_paths) == 6L &&
      all(is.finite(structural_paths$standardized_estimate))
  } else {
    TRUE
  }

  data.frame(
    model_id = run$model_id,
    model = run$model_label,
    normal_termination = run$checks$normal_termination,
    errors_n = length(run$parsed$errors),
    warnings_n = length(run$parsed$warnings),
    maximum_absolute_loading = max(abs(model_loadings$standardized_loading)),
    minimum_standardized_item_residual = min(
      model_loadings$standardized_residual_variance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    minimum_factor_variance = ifelse(
      length(factor_variances),
      min(factor_variances, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    maximum_absolute_factor_relation = max(abs(model_relations$estimate)),
    loading_bounds_ok = loading_bounds_ok,
    item_residuals_nonnegative = item_residuals_nonnegative,
    factor_variances_positive = factor_variances_positive,
    factor_relations_within_bounds = factor_relations_within_bounds,
    structural_paths_complete = structural_paths_complete,
    fit_equivalent_parameterization = all(fit_equivalence$absolute_difference < 1e-6),
    technical_checks_passed =
      run$checks$normal_termination &&
      run$checks$no_fatal_error &&
      loading_bounds_ok &&
      item_residuals_nonnegative &&
      factor_variances_positive &&
      factor_relations_within_bounds &&
      structural_paths_complete,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_diagnostics))

stopifnot(
  nrow(diagnostics) == 2L,
  all(diagnostics$normal_termination),
  all(diagnostics$errors_n == 0L),
  all(diagnostics$technical_checks_passed)
)

knitr::kable(diagnostics, digits = 4)
```

# Visualize the latent structural model

The path diagram is a structural summary rather than a 42-box item diagram.
Each latent-variable node reports its number of indicators and the range of
Mplus STDYX loadings, preserving the measurement-model information without
making the structural paths unreadable. All edges and labels are assembled
from the already extracted Mplus results and drawn with `tidySEM`; no model is
re-estimated in R.

```{r visualize-latent-sem, fig.width=13, fig.height=8, out.width="100%"}
structural_loadings <- loadings |>
  dplyr::filter(model_id == "Structural_CorePeripheral")
structural_relations <- factor_relations |>
  dplyr::filter(model_id == "Structural_CorePeripheral")

loading_range_label <- function(factor_name) {
  values <- structural_loadings$standardized_loading[
    structural_loadings$factor == factor_name
  ]
  sprintf(
    "Std. loading = %.3f-%.3f",
    min(values),
    max(values)
  )
}

outcome_r_squared <- tapply(
  structural_paths$outcome_r_squared,
  structural_paths$outcome,
  unique
)

sem_node_labels <- c(
  PERIPH = paste(
    "Peripheral PSMU",
    "6 BSMAS items",
    loading_range_label("PERIPH"),
    sep = "\n"
  ),
  CORE = paste(
    "Core PSMU",
    "12 BSMAS items",
    loading_range_label("CORE"),
    sep = "\n"
  ),
  DEP = paste(
    "Depression",
    "7 CES-D items",
    loading_range_label("DEP"),
    sprintf("R2 = %.3f", outcome_r_squared[["DEP"]]),
    sep = "\n"
  ),
  ANX = paste(
    "Anxiety",
    "7 DASS items",
    loading_range_label("ANX"),
    sprintf("R2 = %.3f", outcome_r_squared[["ANX"]]),
    sep = "\n"
  ),
  STR = paste(
    "Perceived stress",
    "10 PSS items",
    loading_range_label("STR"),
    sprintf("R2 = %.3f", outcome_r_squared[["STR"]]),
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

sem_nodes <- data.frame(
  name = names(sem_node_labels),
  label = unname(sem_node_labels),
  shape = "oval",
  fill = c("#FCE4D6", "#DDEBF7", rep("#E2F0D9", 3)),
  colour = c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", rep("#4D6B53", 3)),
  linewidth = 0.8,
  label_family = "sans",
  label_fontface = c("bold", "bold", "plain", "plain", "plain"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

sem_regression_edges <- structural_paths |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    from = predictor,
    to = outcome,
    arrow = "last",
    label = sprintf(
      "beta = %.3f\np %s",
      standardized_estimate,
      ifelse(
        standardized_p < .001,
        "< .001",
        sprintf("= %.3f", standardized_p)
      )
    ),
    linetype = ifelse(standardized_p < .05, 1, 2),
    colour = ifelse(predictor == "CORE", "#0072B2", "#D55E00"),
    linewidth = ifelse(standardized_p < .05, 1.15, 0.75),
    alpha = ifelse(standardized_p < .05, 1, 0.58),
    label_size = 3.3,
    label_family = "sans",
    label_fill = "white",
    label_alpha = 0.92,
    label_colour = "#222222",
    label_location = 0.5,
    edge_type = "regression"
  )

sem_correlation_edges <- structural_relations |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    from = factor_1,
    to = factor_2,
    arrow = "both",
    label = ifelse(
      relation_type == "Exogenous factor correlation",
      sprintf("r = %.3f", estimate),
      sprintf("residual r = %.3f", estimate)
    ),
    linetype = 3,
    colour = "#666666",
    linewidth = 0.75,
    alpha = 0.9,
    label_size = 3,
    label_family = "sans",
    label_fill = "white",
    label_alpha = 0.92,
    label_colour = "#333333",
    label_location = 0.5,
    edge_type = ifelse(
      relation_type == "Exogenous factor correlation",
      "exogenous_correlation",
      "residual_correlation"
    )
  )

sem_edges <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  sem_regression_edges,
  sem_correlation_edges
)

sem_layout <- tidySEM::get_layout(
  "PERIPH", "", "", "", "DEP",
  "", "", "", "", "ANX",
  "CORE", "", "", "", "STR",
  rows = 3
)

sem_graph_data <- tidySEM::prepare_graph(
  edges = sem_edges,
  nodes = sem_nodes,
  layout = sem_layout,
  ellipses_width = 3.2,
  ellipses_height = 1.65,
  spacing_x = 2,
  spacing_y = 2,
  text_size = 3.15,
  angle = 150,
  fix_coord = FALSE
)

positioned_edges <- tidySEM::edges(sem_graph_data)
is_regression <- positioned_edges$edge_type == "regression"
positioned_edges$connect_from[is_regression] <- "right"
positioned_edges$connect_to[is_regression] <- "left"
positioned_edges$curvature[
  is_regression & positioned_edges$from == "PERIPH" &
    positioned_edges$to == "DEP"
] <- NA
positioned_edges$curvature[
  is_regression & positioned_edges$from == "PERIPH" &
    positioned_edges$to == "ANX"
] <- -12
positioned_edges$curvature[

] <- -22
positioned_edges$curvature[
  is_regression & positioned_edges$from == "CORE" &
    positioned_edges$to == "DEP"
] <- 22
positioned_edges$curvature[
  is_regression & positioned_edges$from == "CORE" &
    positioned_edges$to == "ANX"
] <- 12
positioned_edges$curvature[
  is_regression & positioned_edges$from == "CORE" &
    positioned_edges$to == "STR"
] <- NA

is_exogenous_correlation <-
  positioned_edges$edge_type == "exogenous_correlation"
positioned_edges$connect_from[is_exogenous_correlation] <- "left"
positioned_edges$connect_to[is_exogenous_correlation] <- "left"
positioned_edges$curvature[is_exogenous_correlation] <- 65

positioned_edges$connect_from[is_residual_correlation] <- "right"

positioned_edges$curvature[

] <- -45
positioned_edges$curvature[

] <- -35
positioned_edges$label_location[

] <- 0.55
positioned_edges$label_location[

] <- 0.5
positioned_edges$label_location[
  is_residual_correlation & positioned_edges$from == "ANX" &

tidySEM::edges(sem_graph_data) <- positioned_edges

sem_plot <- plot(sem_graph_data) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.30))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Baseline latent-variable SEM",
```

```{r export-workbook}
round_numeric_columns <- function(data, digits = 4L) {
  data |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, digits))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.factor), as.character))
}

workbook_sheets <- list(
  Model_Fit = round_numeric_columns(model_fit),
  Structural_Paths = round_numeric_columns(structural_paths),
  Factor_Relations = round_numeric_columns(factor_relations),
  Loadings = round_numeric_columns(loadings),
  Diagnostics = round_numeric_columns(diagnostics)
)

bruceR::export(
  workbook_sheets,

  overwrite = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

workbook <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook(table_file)
header_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
  fontName = "Arial",
  fontSize = 10,
  fontColour = "#FFFFFF",
  fgFill = "#1F4E78",
  textDecoration = "bold",
  halign = "center",
  valign = "center",
  wrapText = TRUE,
  border = "bottom",
  borderColour = "#163A5C"
)
decimal_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "0.0000")
integer_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "#,##0")
significant_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(fgFill = "#E2F0D9")
integer_columns <- c(
  "observations",
  "free_parameters",
  "df",
  "warnings_n",
  "errors_n",
  "item_order"
)

for (sheet_name in names(workbook_sheets)) {
  sheet_data <- workbook_sheets[[sheet_name]]
  n_rows <- nrow(sheet_data)
  n_columns <- ncol(sheet_data)

  openxlsx::addStyle(
    workbook,
    sheet = sheet_name,
    style = header_style,
    rows = 1,
    cols = seq_len(n_columns),
    gridExpand = TRUE,
    stack = TRUE
  )
  openxlsx::setRowHeights(workbook, sheet_name, rows = 1, heights = 32)
  openxlsx::freezePane(workbook, sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
  openxlsx::addFilter(workbook, sheet_name, rows = 1, cols = seq_len(n_columns))
  openxlsx::showGridLines(workbook, sheet_name, showGridLines = FALSE)

  widths <- vapply(seq_len(n_columns), function(index) {
    values <- c(names(sheet_data)[index], as.character(sheet_data[[index]]))
    values[is.na(values)] <- ""
    min(36, max(10, max(nchar(values), na.rm = TRUE) + 2))
  }, numeric(1))
  openxlsx::setColWidths(
    workbook,
    sheet = sheet_name,
    cols = seq_len(n_columns),
    widths = widths
  )

  if (n_rows > 0L) {
    numeric_indices <- which(vapply(sheet_data, is.numeric, logical(1)))
    integer_indices <- which(names(sheet_data) %in% integer_columns)
    decimal_indices <- setdiff(numeric_indices, integer_indices)
    if (length(integer_indices)) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        workbook,
        sheet = sheet_name,
        style = integer_style,
        rows = 2:(n_rows + 1L),
        cols = integer_indices,
        gridExpand = TRUE,
        stack = TRUE
      )
    }
    if (length(decimal_indices)) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        workbook,
        sheet = sheet_name,
        style = decimal_style,
        rows = 2:(n_rows + 1L),
        cols = decimal_indices,
        gridExpand = TRUE,
        stack = TRUE
      )
    }
  }
}

if ("standardized_p" %in% names(workbook_sheets$Structural_Paths)) {
  significant_rows <- which(

}

repair_orphan_drawing_relationships <- function(xlsx_file) {
  repair_dir <- tempfile("baseline_cfa_xlsx_repair_")
  dir.create(repair_dir)
  on.exit(unlink(repair_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  members <- utils::unzip(xlsx_file, list = TRUE)$Name
  # Reject unsafe archive paths before extracting a package.
  unsafe_member <- function(path) {
    parts <- strsplit(gsub("\\\\", "/", path), "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    grepl("^[/\\\\]|^[A-Za-z]:", path) || any(parts == "..")
  }
  stopifnot(length(members) > 0L, !anyDuplicated(members),
            !any(vapply(members, unsafe_member, logical(1))))
  utils::unzip(xlsx_file, exdir = repair_dir)
  relationship_files <- list.files(
    file.path(repair_dir, "xl", "worksheets", "_rels"),
    pattern = "\\.rels$", full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (!length(relationship_files)) return(invisible(0L))

  resolve_member <- function(target) {
    target <- gsub("\\\\", "/", utils::URLdecode(target))
    if (!nzchar(target) || grepl("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:", target)) {
      stop("Invalid internal drawing target")
    }
    parts <- strsplit(target, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    result <- if (startsWith(target, "/")) character() else c("xl", "worksheets")
    for (part in parts) {
      if (!nzchar(part) || part == ".") next
      if (part == "..") {
        if (!length(result)) stop("Drawing target escapes the workbook package")
        result <- head(result, -1L)
      } else result <- c(result, part)
    }
    paste(result, collapse = "/")
  }
  drawing_types <- paste0(
    "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/",
    c("drawing", "vmlDrawing")
  )
  removed_relationships <- 0L
  for (relationship_file in relationship_files) {
    document <- xml2::read_xml(relationship_file, options = "NONET")
    relationships <- xml2::xml_find_all(
      document, "/*[local-name()='Relationships']/*[local-name()='Relationship']"
    )
    changed <- FALSE
    for (relationship in relationships) {
      type <- xml2::xml_attr(relationship, "Type")
      external <- identical(xml2::xml_attr(relationship, "TargetMode"), "External")
      if (!type %in% drawing_types || external) next
      target <- xml2::xml_attr(relationship, "Target")
      if (is.na(target)) stop("Drawing relationship is missing its Target")
      if (!resolve_member(target) %in% members) {
        xml2::xml_remove(relationship)
        removed_relationships <- removed_relationships + 1L
        changed <- TRUE
      }
    }
    if (changed) xml2::write_xml(document, relationship_file)
  }
  if (removed_relationships == 0L) return(invisible(0L))

  repaired_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
  on.exit(unlink(repaired_file), add = TRUE)
  archive_members <- list.files(
    repair_dir, recursive = TRUE, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE
  )
  zip::zipr(
    zipfile = repaired_file, files = archive_members, root = repair_dir,
    include_directories = FALSE, mode = "mirror"
  )
  stopifnot(file.exists(repaired_file), file.info(repaired_file)$size > 0)
  stopifnot(file.copy(repaired_file, xlsx_file, overwrite = TRUE))
  invisible(removed_relationships)
}

orphan_relationships_removed <- repair_orphan_drawing_relationships(table_file)
stopifnot(
  file.exists(table_file),
  file.info(table_file)$size > 0,
  identical(openxlsx::getSheetNames(table_file), names(workbook_sheets))
)
```

```{r verify-workbook}
  nrow(workbook_reload$Factor_Relations) == 14L,
  nrow(workbook_reload$Loadings) == 84L,
  nrow(workbook_reload$Diagnostics) == 2L,
  all(workbook_reload$Diagnostics$technical_checks_passed)
)

workbook_audit <- data.frame(
  sheet = expected_sheets,
  rows = vapply(workbook_reload, nrow, integer(1)),
  columns = vapply(workbook_reload, ncol, integer(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(workbook_audit)
```

# Save and reload the canonical S2.4 RDA

```{r save-result-bundle}
fit_s2_8_baseline_sem <- list(
  metadata = list(
    generated_by = "Step_2_Measurement_Models/S2_4_BaselineSEM_PSMU_PsychologicalDistress.Rmd",
    input_file = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step2_measurement.rda",
    input_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(measurement_file)),
    mplus_version = "8.7",

    parameterization = "DELTA",
    participants = 209L,
    workbook = "Res_3_Results/Table_S2_4_BaselineSEM_PSMU_PsychologicalDistress.xlsx",
    workbook_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(table_file)),
    figure = "Res_3_Results/Figure_S2_4_BaselineSEM_PSMU_PsychologicalDistress.svg",
    figure_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(figure_file)),

      "tidySEM ",

      grepl("<svg", svg_text, fixed = TRUE) &&
      !grepl("<image", svg_text, fixed = TRUE) &&

  ),
  input_audit = input_audit,
  transformations = transformation_audit,
  variable_map = variable_map,

  model_syntax = lapply(model_specs, `[[`, "model"),

)

save(
  fit_s2_8_baseline_sem,

)

verification_environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
verified_objects <- load(result_file, envir = verification_environment)
stopifnot(
  identical(verified_objects, "fit_s2_8_baseline_sem"),
  isTRUE(verification_environment$fit_s2_8_baseline_sem$metadata$s2_8_passed),
  identical(
    verification_environment$fit_s2_8_baseline_sem$metadata$input_md5,
    unname(tools::md5sum(measurement_file))
  ),
  identical(
    verification_environment$fit_s2_8_baseline_sem$metadata$workbook_md5,
    unname(tools::md5sum(table_file))
  ),
  identical(
    verification_environment$fit_s2_8_baseline_sem$metadata$figure_md5,
    unname(tools::md5sum(figure_file))
  ),
  nrow(verification_environment$fit_s2_8_baseline_sem$structural_paths) == 6L,
  nrow(verification_environment$fit_s2_8_baseline_sem$sem_nodes) == 5L,
  nrow(verification_environment$fit_s2_8_baseline_sem$sem_edges) == 10L
)

artifact_audit <- data.frame(
```

# Result summary

```{r result-summary}
path_summary <- structural_paths |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    significant = standardized_p < .05,
    direction = ifelse(standardized_estimate >= 0, "Positive", "Negative")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    outcome_label,
    predictor_label,
    standardized_estimate,
    standardized_se,
    standardized_p,
    standardized_ci_lower,
    standardized_ci_upper,
    outcome_r_squared,
    direction,
    significant
  )

knitr::kable(path_summary, digits = 4)
```

The regression coefficients are mutually adjusted: each Core coefficient
controls for Peripheral, and each Peripheral coefficient controls for Core.
They are cross-sectional latent associations and must not be interpreted as
causal effects. Statistical significance of one path and nonsignificance of
another does not establish that the two coefficients differ; S2.4 does not test coefficient equality.

```{r validation-checks, include=FALSE}
validation_checks <- data.frame(
  check = c(
    "S2.1 contains all 42 required baseline items",
    "Documented anxiety and perceived-stress transformations were applied only to S2.4 data",
    "Both Mplus inputs contain the exact author text",
    "Both models use categorical WLSMV with Delta parameterization",
    "Measurement and structural models terminated normally",
    "No fatal Mplus error or post-hoc item residual modification occurred",
    "Measurement and structural parameterizations have identical global fit",
    "All 84 loading rows are finite and admissible",
    "All six structural paths and three outcome R-squared values were extracted",
    "The tidySEM figure contains five latent nodes, ten model edges, and a vector-only SVG",
    "The five-sheet workbook reloaded with the expected dimensions",
    "The canonical RDA contains one verified object",
    "All six Mplus audit files exist and match their recorded hashes"
  ),
  passed = c(
    all(all_model_items %in% names(dat_step2_measurement$baseline)),
    identical(dat_step2_measurement$baseline, dat_baseline_raw) &&
      all(variable_map$transformation[variable_map$construct == "Anxiety"] ==
        "Shifted from 1-4 to 0-3 using x - 1") &&
      sum(variable_map$transformation == "Reverse-scored using 6 - x") == 4L,
    all(vapply(model_runs, function(x) x$checks$author_present, logical(1))),
    all(vapply(
      model_runs,
      function(x) x$checks$categorical_declared &&
        x$checks$wlsmv_declared && x$checks$delta_declared,
      logical(1)
    )),
    all(diagnostics$normal_termination),
    all(vapply(
      model_runs,
      function(x) x$checks$no_fatal_error && x$checks$no_posthoc_modification,
      logical(1)
    )),
    all(fit_equivalence$absolute_difference < 1e-6),
    nrow(loadings) == 84L &&
      all(abs(loadings$standardized_loading) <= 1.01) &&
      all(loadings$standardized_residual_variance >= -1e-6),
    nrow(structural_paths) == 6L &&
      all(is.finite(structural_paths$outcome_r_squared)),
    nrow(tidySEM::nodes(sem_graph_data)) == 5L &&
      nrow(tidySEM::edges(sem_graph_data)) == 10L &&
      file.exists(figure_file) &&
      identical(
        unname(tools::md5sum(figure_file)),
        figure_audit$md5[figure_audit$format == "SVG"]
      ) &&
      !grepl("<image", svg_text, fixed = TRUE) &&
      !grepl("data:image", svg_text, fixed = TRUE),
    identical(workbook_audit$rows, c(2L, 6L, 14L, 84L, 2L)),
    identical(verified_objects, "fit_s2_8_baseline_sem"),
    all(file.exists(mplus_files$file)) &&
      identical(unname(tools::md5sum(mplus_files$file)), mplus_files$md5)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (!all(validation_checks$passed)) {
  stop(
    "S2.4 validation failed: ",
    paste(validation_checks$check[!validation_checks$passed], collapse = "; ")
  )
}


```
